name: Axion SpheroGuide MEA M768-SPH-48B 48 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Axion BioSystems SpheroGuide MEA 48, black-walled microelectrode array plate with a transparent well bottom, for spheroid and organoid MEA assays on Maestro Pro / Maestro Edge. Single catalogue number M768-SPH-48B; Axion lists no other well count or colour variant of the SpheroGuide line as of 2026-08. Units in meters. All dimensions from the Axion datasheet 'SPHEROGUIDE MEA 48 DATASHEET', document M768-SPH-48B DATASHEET v2: plate length (A) 127.76 mm, plate width (B) 85.48 mm, A1 offset row (C) 10.04 mm, A1 offset column (D) 18.10 mm, well-to-well distance (E) 13.08 mm, well top diameter (F) 7.0 mm, well bottom diameter (G) 2.5 mm, well height (H) 13.2 mm, well bottom elevation (I) 1.15 mm, base thickness (J) 150 um, well volume 435 uL, working volume 300 uL. Grid is 6 rows x 8 columns, read from the datasheet plan view. Axion's 'A1 Offset (Row) (C)' is measured from the top edge and 'A1 Offset (Column) (D)' from the left edge, confirmed against the dimensioned plan view; both are exactly the centred values, (85.48 - 5 x 13.08) / 2 = 10.04 and (127.76 - 7 x 13.08) / 2 = 18.10. Plate height is NOT published by Axion; the 14.35 mm here is derived as well bottom elevation + well height (1.15 + 13.2), which coincides with the usual ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 plate height - it is unverified against a physical plate. Well cross-section is a cylindrical upper bore of 7.0 mm tapering through the SpheroGuide placement funnel to a flat 2.5 mm transparent recording floor; 'diameter' is the top diameter and 'bottom_shape' flat describes that floor, so the funnel wall is not represented by the schema. The frustum volume of a pure 7.0 -> 2.5 mm cone over 13.2 mm is only about 251 uL against the stated 435 uL, which is consistent with the funnel occupying just the lower part of the well rather than the whole depth. Base thickness 150 um is the working-distance number. Each well carries 16 PEDOT electrodes (50 um diameter, 350 um spacing) on SU-8 insulation over an 1.1 x 1.1 mm recording area centred in the well floor; these sit in the imaging field. Axion publishes no plate material, no lid dimension and no tolerances. The Axion CytoView MEA 48 (M768-tMEA-48B / -48W) shares this footprint, pitch and both A1 offsets but is a different mould - 10.35 mm top diameter, 5.30 mm bottom, 12.15 mm well height - so do not use this definition for a CytoView plate.
